episodeTitle.en: Inside ChatGPT: The fastest growing product in history  | Nick Turley (OpenAI)
episodeTitle.zh: 《深入ChatGPT：史上增长最快的产品》 | 尼克·特利（OpenAI）

guestBioOfficial.en: Nick Turley is Head of ChatGPT, the fastest-growing product in history, with 700 million weekly active users (10% of the world’s population). He was part of the original hackathon team that shipped ChatGPT in just 10 days, helped it grow from zero to billions in revenue, and leads product for what may be the most consequential product of our time. We recorded this the day before GPT-5 launched. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 尼克·特利（Nick Turley）：ChatGPT团队负责人

title.en: Inside ChatGPT: The fastest growing product in history  | Nick Turley (OpenAI)
title.zh: 《深入ChatGPT：史上增长最快的产品》 | 尼克·特利（OpenAI）

summary.en: Nick recalls joining OpenAI when it was a research lab and his first task was almost trivial, before helping build what became ChatGPT from a hackathon codebase. He shares the scrappy origin of a product initially expected to fail. The episode offers a behind-the-scenes look at shipping and scaling ChatGPT.
summary.zh: 尼克回忆，自己加入 OpenAI 时它还只是研究实验室，第一个任务近乎琐碎，之后才参与把一个黑客松代码库做成了 ChatGPT。他分享了这款最初被认为会失败的产品——ChatGPT——的草创起源。本期提供了 ChatGPT 上线与规模化的幕后视角。
